spans.s: N. of a celebrated sage and philosopher, founder of the Mīmāṃsā school of philosophy (properly पूर्वमीमांसा); मीमांसाकृतमुन्ममाथ सहसा हस्ती मुनिं जैमिनिम् [[

.]] 
-Comp. 
-भागवतम् N. of a modern revision of [[Bhāg.]] 
-भारतम् N. of a modern revision [[Mb.]] 
-सूत्रम् N. of a work.

a. Relating to or composed by Jaimini. -m. an adherent of Jaimini. -m. (pl.) N. of a school of the [[Sv.]] -n. Jaimini's work. 
-Comp. 
-न्यायमालाविस्तरः N. of a compendium of the Mīmāṃsā philosophy of Mādhava.
